description: Derive and return a digest-only external evidence link between an existing AIPOU workReceiptId and a Technocore transport artifact. It is a pure local calculation: it does not persist the link, call Technocore, sign a message, read a key, verify a transport signature, change AIPOU claim eligibility, or establish delivery. Use it for portable correlation only, and verify the Technocore artifact with its native verifier before relying on the returned link.

issuedAt.description: ISO-8601 time at which this correlation artifact is issued.

transportArtifactDigest.description: Lowercase SHA-256 digest of the canonical Technocore transport artifact bytes.

transportArtifactId.description: Opaque Technocore transport artifact reference. Never send a DID private key, seed, passphrase, wallet, or secret.

name: create_technocore_work_link
